pipeline: OBJ (BodyParts3D, mm, Z-up) -> transform (mm->m, Z-up->Y-up, floor+depth-centered) -> GLB (obj2gltf, binary)
scope_note: Converts muscle + bone records only (structure_type in {muscle,bone}) that are present_in_supplied_package. Teeth (30), eye/orbital anatomy (93), connective tissue (11), and the 11 unassigned-id gap records are explicitly out of scope for this pass -- not relevant to a trigger-point/muscle app.

transform_constants.derivation: Computed from the real combined bounding box of all 634 supplied source OBJ headers (see bodyparts3d/manifests/ investigation), not assumed from the existing skeleton or muscle model.
